metadata.summary: This time-limited state plan amendment responds to the COVID-19 national emergency. The purpose of this amendment is to consider individuals who are evacuated or absent from the state due to the disaster or public health emergency and who intend to return to the state, to continue to be residents of the state. The amendment makes adjustments to the day supply and quantity limit for covered outpatient medications and will make exceptions to their published Preferred Drug List if drug shortages occur. In addition, the amendment increases payment rates for nursing facilities, specialized care providers, and updates the dental fee schedule.
metadata.title: Virginia Medicaid SPA VA-20-0010: Approval Document (approved May 27, 2020, effective March 12, 2020)
